hypothesis: An eligible H8 single-head residual may outperform phase heads, while normalization of phase-output L2 and an orthogonal endgame-weight ablation isolate recipe effects. A fixed longer-budget stage on the selected recipe measures bounded returns from further training.

data.admission: Reuse h4_data.authenticate and all exact v1 audit pins/53-file closure, without altering the v1 contract or evidence. Same retained bytes and original role identities.
data.innerSplit: sha256(UTF8('chessy-h4-v2-inner-20260915') + one NUL byte 0x00 + UTF8(positionFamily)); integer first16 hex modulo5 ==0 is inner-validation; other families inner-training. Existing one-row-per-source-game admission and explicit group-disjoint assertions apply. Reused unchanged for paired v2-control/v3 ablations; no fresh-holdout claim.
data.innerCaveat: New v3 fits do not train on inner-validation labels, but v2 used these labels for checkpoint/recipe selection. These rows were also prior v1 training data and expanded-HCE fit data. This is reused development selection; expanded-HCE inner CE is in-sample, not independent. V3 also selected on this same development split; v4 is exploratory.
data.outerCaveat: NNUE validation was exposed by v1/v2/v3; one v4 final candidate may evaluate it after both recipe and budget selection are frozen. Never report fresh validation evidence. Test remains sealed and dataset opening state persists across contracts.

training.epochs: Stage1:8recipes×300epochs×3seeds=24fits. Stage2:selectedrecipe×900/1800epochs×3seeds=6mandatoryfits. Optional registered3600/7200extensions×3seeds each triggered only by >0.1% latest-budget improvement. Maximum36developmentfits+1refit=37total.
training.optimizer: Adam; beta1=.9,beta2=.999,epsilon=1e-8; analytic float64 gradients; deterministic per-seed minibatch permutation; no optimizer restarts within a fit. Each registered seed/budget fit starts from its registered initialization.
training.schedule: Cosine stretched to each registered 300/900/1800/3600/7200-epoch budget; final refit uses a prefix of its selected budget schedule. All budget fits are independent fresh fits, not continuation experiments.
training.loss: Normalized weighted-mean BCE; coarse endgame row weight1or4, allother rows1. Trunk anchored L2=.01. Single output/bias L2=.01; each MG/EG output/bias L2=.005. Exact tied-head penalty and tied-direction gradient equivalence required.
training.anchor: Original v2/v3 shared-trunk initialization anchors; all output heads/biases anchored atzero. Underlying inference and quantization implementations unchanged.
training.baseline: Frozen shipped integer HCE + one rounded residual; phase heads interpolate before rounding. Control uses unchanged v2 implementation.
training.projection: after each update W1,b1 in[-1.9,1.9]; W2 in[-4,4]; b2 in[-2,2]
training.quantizationAwareMethod: Same v2 parameter STE on both learned phase heads; one final tapered-cp rounding omitted only from differentiable objective.
training.checkpointEligibility: Checkpoint every10 epochs; only after QAT starts. Min exact quantized unweighted inner CE; ties earlier epoch.
training.retryPolicy: Canonical no-replace run marker before role decoding. No score-driven changes/retries; fatal errors preserve evidence and stop. Synthetic fixes before real execution permitted.

selection.recipe: Stage1 complete24fits checked with v3 fail-closed numerical inventory and shipped-only inner phase gate. Select smallest median unweighted inner CE among all8recipes, ties listedorder; freeze recipe before stage2. Stage2 cannot switch recipe.
selection.representativeSeed: For selected budget, median of3 best quantized inner CEs; numeric seed tie-break. Never select luckiestseed.
selection.refit: Exactly1 fresh shared-train fit using final frozen recipe/budget/medianseed. Epoch count is median selected epoch across3seeds at thatbudget; same registered stretched cosine prefix/QAT start. Retain finalepoch, no external checkpoint selection.
selection.freezeBeforeOuter: Architecture recipe frozen before6longerbudgetfits. Then freeze chosen budget,seed,refitepochs and modeldigest before decoding outer. One outercandidate only; no reselection.
selection.qualityGuards: Reuse v1 guard against BOTH frozen comparators: >=0.5% relative CE gain; MAE/RMSE<=1.02x, p99<=1.05x; each phase>=100 rows and CE<=1.01x.
selection.noEligibleCandidate: Publish complete bound result inventory and stop without outer/test. If stage2 fails numerical gates, no candidate. If no budget passes unchanged inner phase guards, no candidate.
selection.saturation: After the frozen300-selectedrecipe mandatory900/1800 stage, conditional3600/7200 extensions use the prospective rule in budgetStage. Choose shortest eligiblebudget within0.1% ofbest median. Always publish saturationReached and endReason. A7200/time/guard cap without plateau is NOT saturation.
selection.innerComparatorRationale: Expanded HCE was fitted on current inner-validation labels and therefore has an in-sample advantage; it is reported but cannot veto inner phase eligibility. Both frozen comparators remain mandatory on exposed outer validation and sealed test with unchanged thresholds. This rule is fixed before any v3 measurements.

quantization.weights: int16 little-endian; biases int32; exact theoretical int32 accumulator/int64 output proofs for<=32pieces
quantization.rounding: phase=min(24,N+B+2R+4Q) both colors; numerator=phase*MG+(24-phase)*EG; floor((numerator*400+24*Q1*Q2/2)/(24*Q1*Q2)), then white sign and shipped integer baseline. Control retains v2 rounding.
quantization.checks: Every chosen development checkpoint: train,inner-validation,authored FENs; final:shared-train,authored,outer. Independent JS scalar BigInt oracle recomputes material phase from FEN. Any numerical failure before selection rejects entire screen.
quantization.sizeCaveat: 13KB ceiling permits offline single H4/H8(6180/12356bytes) and phase H4/H8(6200/12392bytes), not production WASM allowance or integration authority.

test.condition: Separate --open-test-from command after one frozen candidate passes outer and all prior checks, preserving same v1 quality and bootstrap guards; the screen itself never decodes test.
test.marker: Dataset-summary SHA and nnue-test role scoped no-replace registry, independent of contract identity. Refuse if any restored legacy .research-state/*/test-opened.json marker exists. Contract change or renamed output cannot reopen this dataset.
test.failure: Never change candidate after test. Fatal errors consume opening and preserve evidence; no retry.

scope.deviceGate: #84 remains required before runtime integration; reference timing is not device/search timing
scope.formalAcceptance: #175 remains unfinished; no Elo or family-estimator acceptance inferred from offline loss
scope.publication: Only code, exact contract, weight-free reports and source research enter Git. Checkpoints/state remain separately preserved; no automatic new license for derived weights.
scope.stopRule: After this bounded factorial and selected-recipe schedule stage, report results. No additional score-driven recipes, labels, thresholds, restarts or candidate switching after outer/test. Failure keeps shipped evaluator.

budgetStage.eligibility: Same shipped-only inner phase gate and all numerical checks; all3seeds required for eachbudget. Stage1 selected recipe remains fixed.
budgetStage.tieBreak: Smallest nominal epoch budget within1.001x best eligible median CE; representative seed and refit epochs from that budget only.
budgetStage.extensionRule: After mandatory900/1800, if latest phase-eligible median improves the best shorter eligible median by >0.1%, run next registered extension with3seeds. Repeat after3600; stop if improvement<=0.1%, latestbudget phaseguard fails, numericalfailure, elapsed5400sec cap or completed7200. No other budgets.
budgetStage.saturation: saturationReached=true only when latest eligiblebudget relativeimprovement<=0.1% versusbestshorter; endReason=bounded-budget-plateau. Guard/time/maximumepoch caps are false. Evidence pertains only to selectedrecipe and these independent stretched optimizer schedules, never universal convergence.
budgetStage.receiptSchema: Shared test receipt schema remains chessy.h4-v3-test.v1; v4 contractSHA identifies experiment.

factorialAblations.report: Every matched pair along one dimension at300epochs,3seed median and seedrange. Comparison of v4phaseEG1 with frozen v3phase300EG1 isolates output-L2 normalization at H4; old run is historical, not newreplication.
factorialAblations.headNormalization: If MG=EG=single output, sum of two half-lambda phase penalties equals single penalty. Underlying trunk, inference phase and quantization are unchanged.
